;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Lebanese conflict]]
**[[2019 Beirut drone crash]]
***[[Hezbollah]] says two [[Israel]]i [[unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]] went down in the Moawwad neighborhood of [[Dahieh]] (South [[Beirut]]), [[Lebanon]], and they did not shoot them. A small [[reconnaissance]] drone fell on the roof of the Hezbollah media building, then another drone exploded nearby, causing damage to the building. Residents report a loud blast. The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli Army]] says it does not comment on "foreign reports". The [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese Army]] confirms the drones as Israeli. [https://apnews.com/f6838eab9e9f4bb6b587013f26fad961 (AP News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/israeli-drones-beirut-hezbollah-190825052725185.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-lebanon-security-israel/lebanese-army-says-one-israeli-drone-fell-another-exploded-in-beirut-overnight-idUKKCN1VF075 (Reuters)]
*[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War]]
**Iran denies attacks in southern [[Syria]] by Israel hit their installations. The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]], an [[Syrian opposition|opposition]]-aligned medium, claims the missiles killed one Iranian and two people from Hezbollah. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-denies-its-posts-were-hit-in-syria-strike-2-hezbollah-fighters-said-killed/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[2019 Israeli airstrikes in Iraq]]
**Alleged Israeli airstrikes hit a Iran backed [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] convoy near [[Al-Qa'im (town)|Al-Qa'im]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/iraq-paramilitary-israel-drone-attack-syria-border-190825184711737.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**In an escalation of the ongoing protests, a police officer fires a gun whilst clearing protesters; this is the first time a gun has been fired by a police officer in Hong Kong since 1967. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/30/hong-kongs-be-water-protests-leaves-china-casting-about-for-an-enemy (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A helicopter and an [[Ultralight aviation|ultralight airplane]] plane collide near the town of [[Inca, Spain|Inca]], on the island of [[Mallorca]], [[Spain]], killing seven people including two children, according to regional government officials. [https://news.sky.com/story/five-dead-after-helicopter-and-small-plane-collide-in-majorca-11793978 (Sky News)]
*Lightning strikes on at least two [[Alaska Airlines]] planes force them to make emergency landings in [[Southeast Alaska]]. Lightning also knocked out electrical service to the state capital, [[Juneau, Alaska|Juneau]]. [https://www.kfsk.org/2019/08/26/lightning-strikes-reported-on-two-alaska-airlines-flights-sunday-near-juneau/ (Kfsk)]

;Law and crime
*Three people are killed and four others injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a house party in [[Hobbs, New Mexico]], U.S. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/25/us/three-dead-new-mexico-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Rohingya crisis]]
**At [[Kutupalong refugee camp|Kutupalong]], the world's largest [[refugee camp]], in [[Cox's Bazar]], [[Bangladesh]], 200,000 people gather peacefully to remember the day, in 2017, when a [[Northern Rakhine State clashes#25_August_ARSA_attacks|violent crackdown]] by [[Myanmar]]ese security forces compelled 740,000 [[Rohingya]] to flee over the border. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190825-200-000-rohingya-rally-to-mark-genocide-day-in-bangladesh-camps (France24)]
*[[2020 Republican Party presidential primaries]]
**Conservative radio host and former [[List of United States Representatives from Illinois|Illinois]] [[United States House of Representatives|congressman]] [[Joe Walsh (Illinois politician)|Joe Walsh]] announces [[Joe Walsh 2020 presidential campaign|his run]] for president, becoming only the second Republican to challenge incumbent [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/25/politics/joe-walsh-take-on-trump-in-2020-republican-primary/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Abkhazian presidential election]]
**[[International recognition of Abkhazia and South Ossetia|Partially recognized]] [[Abkhazia|Republic of Abkhazia]] holds the first round of the presidential election. Incumbent President [[Raul Khajimba]] and oppositor Alkhas Kvitsinia heads to second round on 8th September. [https://eurasianet.org/abkhazia-presidential-election-heads-to-runoff (Eurasianet)]
